mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO hidden_user (hider_id, hidden_user_id, hidden_role, reason) VALUES (#{hiderId}, #{hiddenUserId}, #{role}, #{reason})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM hidden_user WHERE hider_id = #{hiderId} AND hidden_user_id = #{hiddenUserId}
mapper.select: SELECT h.hidden_user_id AS hiddenUserId, m.role AS role, m.nickName AS nickName, m.image AS image, m.oneWord AS oneWord, h.created_at AS hiddenAt FROM hidden_user h LEFT JOIN member m ON h.hidden_user_id = m.id WHERE h.hider_id = #{hiderId} ORDER BY h.created_at DESC
